newsitem.title: USA: Brazil's Abril in deal to start pay-tv in Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Abril in deal to start pay-tv in Portugal.

text.p: TVA Sistema de Televisao SA, the pay-television subsidiary of Brazil's Abril, said on Friday it had formed an international partnership to launch pay-television in Portugal.
Portuguese multimedia company Lusomundo, telecommunications services company Falcon International Communications, and Chase Manhattan Bank were partners, TVA said in a statement.
The company was not immediately available to provide further details about a possible launch date or financial potential of the deal.
Privately-owned Abril also owns Abril Controljornal, the largest publisher in the Portuguese market. TVA said it was Brazil's largest growing pay-television provider, with over 900,000 customers.
